lines.japanese: 目覚めると、今日も薔薇色の世界が広がっていた。
lines.english: When I awoke, the world was rose-colored once again.

lines.japanese: 「ぐすん……ひっく、ぐすっ……」
lines.english: “Sniff... Hic... Sniff...”

lines.japanese: そんな中、俺は泣きぬれた一夜を過ごした。
lines.english: And there I lay, having spent a night awash in tears.

lines.japanese: 「コヴァッ、コバ、コバとがだって、ぐすっ、チャンネル変えるから、予約が間に合わなくて……」
lines.english: “K-Koba, Koba... because Kobato changed the channel... Sniff... I couldn't reserve the tickets in time...”

lines.japanese: 俺は女々しかった。
lines.english: I was pathetic.

lines.japanese: とはいえ、実のところ小鳩の気持ちも分かる。
lines.english: Though, truth be told, I could understand how Kobato felt.

lines.japanese: 俺が特異な人生を歩んできた一因。ヨッくんこと足利美樹氏は、少なからずその経緯に関わっていた。
lines.english: Yoshiki Ashikaga, better known as Yoshi, had played no small part in the chain of events that led me to my unusual life.

lines.japanese: そのことを知っても、我ながら不思議なぐらい、彼に対して怒りや恨みといったものは湧かなかった。
lines.english: Even after learning that, I felt no anger or resentment toward him, which surprised even me.

lines.japanese: 記憶もかすかな母と同様、子の俺も、彼のファンを卒業することは出来なかったのだ。
lines.english: Just like my mother, whom I barely remembered, I—her son—could not bring myself to stop being his fan.

lines.japanese: やはり、裏切られても愛しつづけた女の血だろうか。あるいは他にも──
lines.english: Perhaps it was the blood of a woman who had kept loving him even after he betrayed her. Or perhaps there was something more—

lines.japanese: ──ともあれ小鳩は（彼女自身が口にしたことはないが）昔も今も割りきれていないみたいだ。足利氏やフリッキー５の話になると、あからさまに抵抗ある素振りを見せる。
lines.english: —At any rate, Kobato had never said so aloud, but she seemed unable to come to terms with it, then or now. Any mention of Ashikaga or Fricky Five made her openly resistant.

lines.japanese: 「ま、仕方ない。当日売りのチケットを狙うか」
lines.english: “Well, nothing I can do about it. I'll shoot for same-day tickets.”

lines.japanese: 俺は気持ちを切りかえると、布団を跳ねとばした。
lines.english: Having put the matter behind me, I flung off the covers.

lines.japanese: 嫌がる小鳩をむりやり連れていくことはない。森里君でも誘って、ふたりで楽しくフリファっちゃおう。
lines.english: There was no need to drag Kobato along against her will. I could invite Morisato and the two of us could Fricky out together.

lines.japanese: そう、女々しいのはここまで。
lines.english: That was enough self-pity.

lines.japanese: 冬休みは昨日で終わり、今日から始まる三学期。大事な節目を笑顔で迎えようじゃないか。
lines.english: Winter break had ended yesterday, and the third term began today. I would greet this important milestone with a smile.

lines.japanese: 「待ってろよ、学校のみんなたち！」
lines.english: “School, my friends—here I come!”

lines.japanese: 冬の寒さの中、パンツ一丁で空を指した。
lines.english: Clad in nothing but my underwear against the winter cold, I pointed dramatically at the sky.

lines.japanese: 今日から小鳩も三学期。すでに登校準備を済ませて、はむはむと朝食をはむついていた。
lines.english: Kobato's third term also began today. Already dressed and ready for school, she was nibble-nibbling her breakfast.

lines.japanese: その姿を眺めているだけで、俺は──
lines.english: The mere sight of her was enough to make me—

lines.japanese: ──嗚呼、小鳩さんのそのパンなど頬張りたる様や、なんと可愛らしくていらっしゃることでせう。
lines.english: —Ah, how exquisitely adorable Miss Kobato appears, her cheeks filled with bread so!

lines.japanese: 制服姿などは更なり。これまさに、世のよしなしごとすべて凌駕する無類の可憐さなれば、わたくしは小鳩さんの魅力にすっかりと──
lines.english: And in uniform, more adorable still. Such matchless loveliness doth eclipse all the vain trifles of this mortal world; its charms have rendered me utterly—

lines.japanese: ──っとと、いかんいかん、また視野を狭めてしまった。制服姿の小鳩が世界レベルで可愛いのは揺るぎない事実だが、そこで完結していては俺自身の成長がない。
lines.english: —Whoa, hold it. There I went narrowing my vision again. Kobato's world-class cuteness in uniform was indisputable fact, but if that was where my thoughts ended, I would never grow.

lines.japanese: 「うーん……」
ところで小鳩は思案顔だった。
lines.english: Kobato, meanwhile, looked deep in thought.

lines.japanese: 「ん、どうした小鳩？　冬休みの宿題でも忘れたのか？」
lines.english: “What's wrong, Kobato? Forget your winter-break homework?”

lines.japanese: 「それならお兄ちゃんがとっておきの必殺技を教えてやろう。まず教室に着くだろ、そしたら吉川さんのノートを取りだすんだ。その名前を自分の名前に変えて……」
lines.english: “If so, Big Brother will teach you his ultimate secret technique. First you get to class, then you take out Yoshikawa's notebook and change the name on it to yours...”

lines.japanese: 「しゅくだいなら吉川さんと二人でちゃんとやったよ。そうじゃなくて、なんていうか、うーん……」
lines.english: “I did my homework properly with Yoshikawa. It's not that. I just... Hmm...”

lines.japanese: 「な、なんだ、どうしたんだ。なにか心配事でもあるのか」
lines.english: “Wh-what is it? Is something worrying you?”

lines.japanese: はっ！　まさか小鳩のやつ、俺と同じように、二週間ぶりの兄の制服姿にときめいて！？
lines.english: Wait! Could Kobato, like me, be thrilled at the sight of her brother in uniform for the first time in two weeks?!

lines.japanese: 「学校あるのに朝ごはんのじゅんびしてないから、なんか物たりないのかも」
lines.english: “I think something feels missing because I didn't have to make breakfast even though it's a school day.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、なーんだ、そういうことか」
lines.english: “Oh. Is that all?”

lines.japanese: そういえば小鳩は、さっきから時間を持てあましてる感じだった。両親不在の生活が身について、用もなく早起きしちゃったってわけか。
lines.english: Come to think of it, Kobato had seemed at loose ends all morning. She’d gotten so used to life with her parents away that she’d woken up early even with nothing to do.

lines.japanese: 「普通なら、朝の手間が減ったんだから喜ぶところなんだぞ」
lines.english: “Normally, you'd be happy to have less work in the morning.”

lines.japanese: 「そうかなあ？　お兄ちゃんがいっぱい食べてくれるから、ごはん作るの楽しかったよ」
lines.english: “Really? You always ate so much, Big Brother. I had fun cooking for you.”

lines.japanese: な、なんていい子なんだ……う、ううっ、やめてくれ。そんなことを言われたら、涙をこらえるのに必死でごはんが食べられないじゃないか……。
lines.english: Wh-what a wonderful girl... N-no, stop. If you say things like that, I'll be too busy fighting back tears to eat...

lines.japanese: 「う、うう～っ、なんていい子なんだ。もっと家事の手伝いしてあげればよかったな」
lines.english: “U-uuugh, you're such a good girl. I should've helped more with the housework.”

lines.japanese: 「ううん。いいよ、そんなの気にしないで。しかたないよ、ずっと二人きりだったんだから――」
lines.english: “No, it's okay. Don't worry about that. It couldn't be helped when it was just the two of us all that time—”

lines.japanese: わたくしたちは共に二人きりという言ノ葉のみくり抜いてしまひ、しばし無言に襲われたのでございます。
lines.english: Together we plucked the words “just the two of us” from her sentence, and for a time silence fell upon us.

lines.japanese: なんとも居住まいの悪き心持ちなれば、また小鳩さんも困ってゐることですし、兎にも角にも談ぜねば二進も三進も参りません。
lines.english: Most ill at ease was I. Yet Miss Kobato was troubled as well, and unless one of us spoke, neither forward nor back could we move.

lines.japanese: 「そ、そういえば叔母さんが帰ってきてから初めての料理を食べたとき、なんだか久しぶりって感じがしなかったな」
lines.english: “C-come to think of it, when Auntie cooked for us for the first time after she came home, it didn't taste like it had been that long.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「ほら、小鳩の料理の味が、叔母さんに近づいたんだよ。見劣りしないくらい」
lines.english: “Your cooking has gotten closer to Auntie’s, Kobato. It can hold its own against hers now.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そうかなあ。お母さんにくらべたら、まだまだだと思うけど」
lines.english: “R-really? I think I've still got a long way to go compared to Mom.”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、大したもんだって。また作る機会があったら食べたいな」
lines.english: “No, no, you've gotten really good. I'd love to eat your cooking again when you get the chance.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そう？　えへへ、嬉しいなあ。じゃあまた二人きりになったら……」
lines.english: “R-really? Heehee, that makes me happy. Then the next time we're alone together...”

lines.japanese: 結局のところ沈黙してしまふ、わたくしたちなのです。
lines.english: And ultimately, we fell silent yet again.

lines.japanese: さりとて昨晩、我が世を広げたらむと誓いし身なれば、いかに小鳩さんがわたくしへ恋慕の情を寄せたる気色あらんとて、かくもたやすく骨を抜かれては具合がよろしくありません──
lines.english: Still, as one who had sworn but last night to broaden his world, I could ill afford to be so easily unmanned, no matter how deeply Miss Kobato's manner hinted at her affection for me—

lines.japanese: うむ。そうだ。俺たちはもっと他の異性を知るべきだ。
lines.english: Yes. That was it. We needed to get to know more members of the opposite sex.

lines.japanese: とくに小鳩は、子供のころからずっと俺の問題にかかりっきりで、あまりよその男と関わる機会もなかっただろう。
lines.english: Kobato in particular had spent her whole childhood consumed by my problems. She'd probably had few opportunities to associate with other boys.

lines.japanese: うちの可愛い妹が、オレ様以外のクソ野郎（通称ＯＩＫ）と話してる姿なんか見たくもないけど、いやいや待て待て、そもそもこの発想自体がいけないんだって。
lines.english: I had no desire to watch my darling sister talk to Any Other Bastard—AOB for short—but wait, wait. That very way of thinking was the problem.

lines.japanese: 「なあ小鳩」
lines.english: “Hey, Kobato.”

lines.japanese: 「ふえっ？」
lines.english: “Hmm?”

lines.japanese: ためしに小鳩へ質問してみよう。あたかも普通の兄のように。
lines.english: I would try asking her a question, just as an ordinary brother might.

lines.japanese: 「小鳩は男のひとで言うと、どんなひとがタイプなんだ」
lines.english: “What kind of man is your type?”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「え、ええええ……」
lines.english: “Wh-whaaaat...?”

lines.japanese: 「な、なんっ、なんでいきなりっ！？」
lines.english: “Wh-why would you suddenly ask me that?!”

lines.japanese: 慌ててる。ちょっとパステルカラーの空気だったから、唐突というか意味深だったかもしれない。
lines.english: She was flustered. The air between us had been rather pastel-colored, so perhaps the question had seemed abrupt. Or suggestive.

lines.japanese: 「い、いやそのっ、べつに深い意味とか興味とか全然ないけどね。その、小鳩がね、教室ではどんな生活しているのか気になって」
lines.english: “N-no, there's no deep meaning behind it, and I'm not interested or anything. I was just wondering what your life is like in the classroom.”

lines.japanese: 「だ、だってうち、女子校っ……」
lines.english: “B-but I go to an all-girls school...”

lines.japanese: あ、そうだった。
lines.english: Oh. Right.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、小学校のころの友達でいいや。うちのクラスの連中……ほら、タッチンとか川嶋とかだと、誰が好きだった？」
lines.english: “Then pick one of your friends from elementary school. Out of the guys in our class—Tatchin or Kawashima, say—who did you like?”

lines.japanese: 「な、ないよっ、そんなのぜんぜんない！」
lines.english: “N-no one! Not at all!”

lines.japanese: 完全否定か。まあ、ほんと子供だったからな、恋愛感情の芽生える歳でもなかったか。
lines.english: An absolute denial. Well, we'd really been children then. Maybe she hadn't reached the age for romantic feelings.

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん以外に、男のひとの知り合いなんていない」
lines.english: “I don't know any men besides you, Big Brother.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、そうなの？」
lines.english: “What? You don't?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、じゃあ森里君なんかどうだい？　ほら、一年の頃に俺とよく買い物に出かけてた。グローヴ街で何度か会ったことあるだろ。あのハンサムなのかイケメンなのかよく分からないひと」
lines.english: “Then how about Morisato? I used to go shopping with him all the time in our first year. You ran into us on Grove Street a few times. The guy who's either handsome or hot—I can never quite decide which.”

lines.japanese: 「森里さんはわかるけど、私、ちょくせつ話したことほとんどないよ」
lines.english: “I know who Morisato is, but I've hardly ever spoken to him myself.”

lines.japanese: 「あれっ、そうだっけ？　ああそうか……紹介したことあるくらいだっけ」
lines.english: “You haven’t? Oh, right... I guess I never did much more than introduce you.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。森里さんと話した時間より、お兄ちゃんのしょうかいの方が長かった」
lines.english: “Yeah. You spent longer introducing Morisato than I spent talking to him.”

lines.japanese: 「ふ、ふーん……」
やはりそうか。うちの妹はＯＩＫとほとんど縁がないみたいだ。うふふ、めでたしめでたし──
lines.english: So it was true. My sister had almost nothing to do with AOBs. Heehee. And they all lived happily ever after—

lines.japanese: ──って、めでたくねぇー！
lines.english: —Nothing about this was happy!

lines.japanese: それは俺の責任でもある。そして何より、大切な妹だからこそ彼女には、もっとたくさんの人間と関わってもらいたい。
lines.english: I bore some responsibility for that. And more than anything, precisely because she was my precious sister, I wanted her to interact with many more people.

lines.japanese: ふうむ……それなら小鳩の世界を広げるために、たまにはＯＩＫでも家へ呼んでみるか。
lines.english: Hmm... In that case, perhaps I should invite an AOB to the house sometime and broaden Kobato's world.

lines.japanese: 「よし、分かった。それじゃ、この話はまた今度だな」
lines.english: “All right, I understand. We'll come back to this another time.”

lines.japanese: 「い、いいよ、そんな話しなくて」
lines.english: “W-we don't have to talk about this at all.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩は真っ赤になりながら、さっさと朝ごはんを食べて台所へ行ってしまった。
lines.english: Bright red, Kobato hurriedly finished breakfast and fled to the kitchen.

lines.japanese: ははは、うちの妹はかわいいなあ……
lines.english: Ha ha ha. My sister was adorable...

lines.japanese: ……っととと、いかんいかん。すぐにデレちゃうこの癖は直さないとな。広い視野、広い視野。
lines.english: Whoa, hold it. I had to break this habit of turning to mush at the drop of a hat. Broader perspective. Broader perspective.

lines.japanese: とは言っても、我ながらあまりに漠然とした目標だな。視野ってのは具体的にどうすれば広がるんだ。
lines.english: Though that was awfully vague as goals went. What was I actually supposed to do to broaden my perspective?

lines.japanese: うーむ、小鳩にばかり勧めてないで、俺の方もいっちょ小鳩以外のクソ女（通称ＫＩＫ）とレンアイなんてものをしてみるか。
lines.english: Hmm. Instead of pushing Kobato alone, maybe I ought to try this romance business with some Bitch Other Than Kobato—BOTK for short.

lines.japanese: 恋愛……ふむ、恋愛……か。
lines.english: Romance... Hmm. Romance...

lines.japanese: ま、まあ、そりゃね？　いままでの俺は、キホンその気がなかっただけだからね。実際その気になったら楽勝だよね、超モテるよね。やばいやばい、愛が溢れちゃうかもね。ははは。
lines.english: W-well, you know? Up to now, I just hadn't been interested. If I ever got serious, it'd be easy. I'd be wildly popular. Oh, no, watch out. I might overflow with love. Ha ha ha.

lines.japanese: 「ようし、今日も薔薇色でいこう！」
lines.english: “All right! Another rose-colored day!”

lines.japanese: さて、出掛ける仕度も済んだことだし、そろそろ小鳩を誘って学校へ──
lines.english: Now that I was ready to leave, it was about time I invited Kobato to walk to school—

lines.japanese: ──と、その前に、本日の日課を済ませおこう。レンアイと言ったら、まず彼にも話を聞いてみたいしな。
lines.english: —but first, I would complete today's daily ritual. If romance was the subject, I wanted to hear what he had to say too.

lines.japanese: 俺は携帯電話を取りだし、『友人と言う枠に収まりたくない』フォルダへ登録してある、掛けなれた番号を呼びだした。
lines.english: I took out my cell phone and called a familiar number saved in the folder labeled “Too Much for Mere Friendship.”

lines.japanese: ぷっ　ぷっ　ぷっ　ぷっ
lines.english: Beep. Beep. Beep. Beep.

lines.japanese: ぷるるるるっ……
lines.english: Brrring...

lines.japanese: 『あーい、もしもし？』
lines.english: “Yello? Who's this?”

lines.japanese: 「もっ」
lines.english: “Mo—”

lines.japanese: もももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももももも
lines.english: Mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo—

lines.japanese: 森里君だ！
lines.english: It was Morisato!

lines.japanese: 「おっ、おはよう森里君！　今日も聞くだけで胸が高鳴るイケ声だね！」
lines.english: “G-good morning, Morisato! That hot voice still sets my heart racing from the first syllable!”

lines.japanese: 『ああ……おうオハヨ、相変わらず元気だねえ』
lines.english: “Uh... yeah, morning. Full of energy as ever, huh?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、俺はとっても元気だよ！　あ、ところでいまちょっと時間いいかな」
lines.english: “I'm doing wonderfully! Oh, do you have a minute?”

lines.japanese: 『いいけど、もう出かけるところだから早めにね』
lines.english: “Sure, but I'm about to leave, so make it quick.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう、やっぱり森里君は俺の親友だね。あ、ところでさ、この電話に意味はないんだ」
lines.english: “Thank you. You really are my best friend, Morisato. Oh, by the way, this call doesn't have a point.”

lines.japanese: 『はあ？』
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「いや今日から三学期じゃない？　それなら、森里君の声を聞いてやる気を出そうと思ったんだ。だって親友の声は勇気の源だからね。元気ムラムラ湧いてくるからね」
lines.english: “Well, the third term starts today, right? I thought hearing your voice might put some fire in me. A best friend's voice is a font of courage. Really gets the juices flowing.”

lines.japanese: 『ああそーなん。よく分かんねーけど、それだけだったらもう切るわ』
lines.english: “Uh-huh. No idea what you're on about, but if that's all, I'm cutting this short.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、切るの？　分かった、今日はハサミを持っていくね。良かった、やっと森里君が髪を切る気になってくれたんだ。そのロンゲ、森里君の唯一の欠点だからね」
lines.english: “You're cutting it? Great! I'll bring scissors today. I'm so glad you're finally willing to cut your hair, Morisato. That mane is your one and only flaw.”

lines.japanese: 『うっ、うるっせえハゲ！　テメーこそ今すぐ髪切ってハゲになれハゲ！』
lines.english: “Sh-shut up, baldy! You should cut yours right now and go bald, you bald bastard!”

lines.japanese: 「ひ、酷いよ森里君。あ、そうだ。そういえば森里君に相談があったんだ。恋愛のことで悩んでるんだけど」
lines.english: “That's awful, Morisato. Oh, right! I did have something I wanted to ask you about. I've been having trouble with romance.”

lines.japanese: 『はあ？　羽田が恋愛相談？　へー、面白そうじゃん。言ってみ？』
lines.english: “What? Haneda wants love advice? Huh. Sounds interesting. Let's hear it.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。じゃあ聞くけど、森里君はあんなにかっこいいのにどうして女の子からモテないのかな」
lines.english: “Okay, then tell me: when you're so handsome, why aren't you popular with girls?”

lines.japanese: 『俺の恋愛相談かよ！』
lines.english: “This is about my love life?!”

lines.japanese: 「うん。本当は聞きたいこともあったんだけど、親友の心配を優先したいからね。教えてよ森里君、どうして森里君はモテないんだよ。あのロンゲが悪いんじゃないかと思うんだけど、どうすれば切ってくれるかな！」
lines.english: “Of course. I did have something I wanted to ask, but my best friend's problems come first. Tell me, Morisato—why aren't you popular? I think the long hair's the problem. How can I convince you to cut it?!”

lines.japanese: プツッ！
lines.english: Click!

lines.japanese: あ、切られた。
lines.english: Oh. He cut me off.

lines.japanese: ははは、こうなることは分かってるのに、毎回わざわざ俺の電話に出てくれる森里君は本当に律儀だなあ。
lines.english: Ha ha ha. He knows exactly how this will end, but he still goes out of his way to answer every call. Morisato is so conscientious.
